name: Poindexter
summary: Local-first engine that discovers topics, researches, writes, QA-reviews, and publishes posts.
use_cases: discover trending topics from HackerNews and Dev.to
research topics with web search and source verification
write long-form posts with local LLMs
review drafts with multi-model adversarial QA
publish posts via static JSON export to any frontend

pitfalls.actually_needed: poindexter tasks list / settings list / doctor all exit 0 but print 'Error: No DSN' / 'No worker API URL configured' until 'poindexter setup --auto' seeds bootstrap.toml and the Docker stack runs

evidence.quote: No managed/hosted offering yet. Self-host only.
Run it on your machine. Own your data. No cloud lock-in.
Ollama for inference. Your GPU, your data, zero API costs.
One engine that discovers topics, researches them, writes long-form posts, tears them apart in review, and publishes the survivors
Poindexter™ is the production system behind [gladlabs.io](https://www.gladlabs.io)
**Windows:** run from Git Bash or WSL2. **Linux:** Ollama has to listen beyond loopback
an NVIDIA GPU is strongly recommended: the default writer and critic are 27B and 14B models
